title: The Care Calculus: A Mechanized Linear Type Theory for Safe Agents
description: We present the Care Calculus: a multi-sorted linear logic with coalgebraic generators, guarded recursion, and resource-linear destructors. While initially developed to model the derivation of care in self-referential systems, the calculus provides a general framework for all unitary, non-duplicable resource flows. We mechanize the calculus in Lean 4, proving that the No-Cloning theorem and Unitarity emerge as structural theorems of the grammar: a derivation of contraction would be a cloner, and a derivation of vanishing would be an eraser. The artifact contains the complete Lean 4 development (Lean 4.35.0, no Mathlib): the library Dcare, a per-theorem axiom audit, the two build gates (build and disclosure, and the paper-anchor check), and the paper's markdown source. The two unrestricted classical linearity statements are carried as named conjectures with five proven fragment strengths each, the deepest of which integrate the care machinery; axioms beyond propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound appear nowhere, and the one theorem asserting independence from the withheld constructive companion is enforced by the audit rather than claimed. The paper's section 16 states the tiered disclosure: the concrete constraint-type assignment and the constructive instantiation are withheld, and the companion is not part of this deposit.
notes: Deposit license is CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0, covering paper/paper.md, paper.pdf and any figures. The Lean 4 development (lean/) and the gate scripts (scripts/) are licensed AGPL-3.0-or-later (see LICENSE). These terms are deliberate: this is a dual-use artifact and it is not offered for incorporation into commercial systems. The development is split into two formal systems: the unrestricted calculus (the adversarial baseline) and the Guarded kernel. Both of the unrestricted linearity laws are now settled and they are settled in opposite directions — vanishing is refuted by a machine-checked counterexample (unrestricted_counterexample: an explicit [content] ⊢ unit derivation), while contraction is proved (no_contraction_content, by the monotone counting model) — and in the Guarded kernel both are absolute theorems. The development carries no sorryAx anywhere: every cited theorem's axiom list is one of propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. The confidential companion described in the paper's section 16 is withheld and is not part of this deposit. scripts/sync-check.sh checks all 92 paper anchors against the declarations in this deposit; all resolve. Both laws are decided in one import-free file, reproducer/minimal-reproducer.lean (~430 lines, no Mathlib, no build): the counterexample to unrestricted vanishing, the monotone counting model that proves unrestricted contraction, and the check that the same model accepts the counterexample — one interpretation choice, one law each way. The gate compiles it.
